description: Two-seat F-104F Starfighter conversion trainer, c/n 483-5073, preserved on a public road beside the gate of Fliegerhorst Nörvenich. Only about 30 F-104Fs were built, all for the Luftwaffe.
Panavia Tornado IDS, c/n GS092, gate guardian of Fliegerhorst Nörvenich, home of Taktisches Luftwaffengeschwader 31 Boelcke.
Fokker-built F-104G Starfighter, c/n 8231, held at Nörvenich as a ground instructional airframe inside the base.

Second F-104G Starfighter preserved at Fliegerhorst Nörvenich, the base where the Luftwaffe first introduced the Starfighter in 1960. Recorded by the International F-104 Society survey of preserved German Starfighters; presence not independently re-confirmed by a dated photograph.
